title: Multi-Game Decision Transformers
summary: Scales our Multi-Game Decision Transformer line into a generalist-agent milestone: a single transformer with one set of weights, trained purely offline, playing up to 46 Atari games at close-to-human level, with performance scaling by model size and rapid fine-tuning to new games. Aim is an internal generalist-agent checkpoint plus a fine-tuning recipe other teams can adopt.
